title: Pipedrive Nova: AI Meeting Intelligence, Summaries, and CRM Updates
text:
Pipedrive Nova: AI Meeting Intelligence, Summaries, and CRM Updates

| News| Nov 11, 2026

# Pipedrive Launches Nova AI for Meeting Preparation, Transcription, and CRM Updates

On September 16, 2026, Pipedrive announced the global launch of Nova, a built-in AI tool for working with customer meetings and phone calls. Nova analyzes customer information before a call, records and transcribes meetings, creates summaries, and suggests CRM changes based on the discussion.

Unlike standalone transcription services, Nova is integrated directly with Pipedrive. The tool uses existing data on contacts, organizations, and deals, and links the results of conversations to the corresponding CRM records.

Nova is available to users on all Pipedrive plans at no additional cost.

## Meeting Preparation Based on CRM Data

Before a scheduled meeting, Nova automatically creates a Pre-call Brief using the available CRM information: the deal history, previous communications, email correspondence, notes, and recent activities.

The prepared brief may include:

- Information about the current deal and its history.
- Details about the organization and the meeting participants.
- The results of previous calls and correspondence.
- Recent changes and actions related to the customer.
- A list of questions and tasks to keep in mind during the conversation.

...

## Recording and Transcribing Meetings in Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams

During calls, Nova captures the content of the conversation using AI Notetaker.

Two recording options are available for online meetings.

The first involves adding AI Notetaker as a separate participant in Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams. The user can invite the assistant manually or set it to join eligible meetings from the calendar automatically.

The second option uses the Nova Companion app for Windows and macOS. It records audio directly from the computer, so no separate bot appears among the video conference participants.

The app makes it possible to process not only meetings in popular video conferencing services but also other VoIP calls, phone calls, and in-person meetings, as long as the computer can record their audio.

After the conversation ends, Nova provides a text transcript with timestamps. The user can jump from a highlighted action to the corresponding part of the conversation.

It is also possible to upload the transcript of a meeting recorded without Nova for subsequent analysis.

...

After the meeting ends, Nova analyzes the transcript and creates a structured summary.

It highlights the main issues discussed, the agreements reached, important details, and next steps.

For example, if during the call the customer agreed to an additional product demo, requested a commercial proposal, or indicated an expected decision date, Nova can highlight these agreements in the final summary.

The summary can be saved as a note linked to the corresponding deal, contact, or organization in Pipedrive.

...

## Suggestions for Updating the CRM After Calls

One of Nova's key features is turning information from conversations into suggestions for updating CRM data.

Based on the transcript, the tool can suggest changing:

- The deal stage.
- The deal value.
- The expected close date.
- The customer's contact details.
- Fields on organization and contact records.
- Custom fields and labels.

For example, if during the conversation the customer confirmed the agreed budget and the expected timeline for signing the contract, Nova can suggest updating the deal value and its expected close date.

Each suggested change is shown next to the current value of the field.

Nova does not change existing CRM data without the user's confirmation. The sales rep can accept the suggestion, adjust the value, or reject it.

At the same time, field change suggestions are generated based on meeting transcripts. Synced email correspondence is used to prepare for calls but does not serve as a standalone source of such suggestions.

...

A Pipedrive administrator can manage employee access to Nova. According to the company, customer data is not used to train third-party AI models.

## Nova Availability and Cost

As of September 16, 2026, Nova's core features became generally available worldwide.

The tool is included in all Pipedrive plans at no additional cost. Using the basic functionality does not require purchasing a separate product or connecting a third-party service.

Nova works in a separate tab in Pipedrive that brings together call preparation, transcripts, summaries, and CRM update suggestions.

## Which Companies Pipedrive Nova Is Intended For

Pipedrive is a CRM platform for managing contacts, leads, deals, and sales processes. The system is aimed primarily at small and medium-sized businesses, as well as teams that work with long sales cycles and regular customer communications.

Nova extends the platform's functionality in the area of Conversation Intelligence by linking the content of conversations to specific CRM data.

For B2B companies and service businesses, the tool makes it possible to reduce manual meeting preparation and documentation of their results, systematize agreements with customers, and keep deal information up to date.

Nova can be especially useful for sales teams in which a significant part of customer interaction takes place through video conferences, phone calls, and in-person meetings.

title: Pipedrive proposes its largest restructuring, citing lost search traffic - TrustList
text:
## Pipedrive proposes its largest restructuring, citing lost search traffic

29 October 2026: Pipedrive, the Tallinn-founded CRM maker, is proposing the largest structural change in its history, and chief executive Paulo Cunha says the majority of the company's current roles would be affected. His reason is commercial: small businesses increasingly ask AI for software recommendations, so the free traffic that powered Pipedrive's growth has declined sharply and the paid traffic it bought to replace it costs more.

Not yet independently verified. Pipedrive's letter gives no job numbers and does not name offices; the figures for Estonia, the Lisbon closure and the Prague and Berlin effects come from Äripäev as relayed by ERR News and Estonian World, and the letter says the changes are proposals. No change to Pipedrive's pricing, product or support is announced in the letter. We will update this when it can be confirmed, and remove this note.

### What the chief executive's letter says

Cunha's letter to staff, published in the company's newsroom, proposes to reduce the size and complexity of the company across all its locations: fewer teams, fewer layers and fewer locations. How and when this happens differs by country because employment law differs. Where consultation is required, he writes, no final decisions will be made until it ends. The letter gives no headcount and names no office.

He says this is not an exercise in using AI to reduce costs, nor in replacing people with AI. In his words, AI has changed what customers want and how they find the product, which is why strategy, team and operating model have to change.

### The traffic problem behind the plan

Pipedrive, the letter says, grew by acquiring customers efficiently online, keeping them as they grew, and earning more from them over time. The letter gives no traffic or cost figures, but it describes the first leg as broken: free traffic down sharply, paid traffic more expensive. Cunha adds that the company had already invested more in product and marketing, reorganised R&D and significantly reduced operating costs, and that those steps were not enough on their own.

The new plan includes building demand first through the product, supported by brand and content, and reducing reliance on paid search.

### Nova and a narrower customer

On the product side the letter commits to keep investing in the core CRM, with a sharper focus on quality and reliability, and to build what it calls an AI-native sales system for teams. Nova is described as the beginning: it captures sales conversations, keeps records up to date, recommends next steps and takes on routine work. The company says it will sharpen its focus on salespeople and sales teams, and bring more core teams into the same office.

Nothing in the letter changes pricing, plans or support for existing customers, and we do not infer anything beyond what it states. Our catalogue lists CRM software, including Pipedrive's rivals.

...

The numbers come from the press, not from Pipedrive's letter. ERR News, citing the Estonian business daily Äripäev, reports that Pipedrive is cutting 70 percent of its Estonian workforce: 219 jobs in Tallinn and 48 in Tartu, out of 380 employees in the country. Estonian World, also relaying Äripäev, reports that the Lisbon office, with about 220 people, is set to close, along with a smaller operation in Prague, and that developers in Berlin will be affected.

...

The consultations the letter describes are still running, and the final shape of the cuts waits on them.

title: Pipedrive Pricing: Plans, Add-Ons and Real Seat Costs
text:
Pipedrive pricing runs $14 to $69 per seat a month on annual billing: Lite $14, Growth $24, Premium $49 and Ultimate $69. Monthly billing costs $19 to $89 per seat.

The plan price is only part of the bill. You pay for every seat, filled or empty, and LeadBooster, Campaigns and Web Visitors cost extra on lower plans.

...

## Key Points

- Pipedrive pricing per seat a month is $14 (Lite), $24 (Growth), $49 (Premium) and $69 (Ultimate) on annual billing, or $19, $34, $64 and $89 billed monthly. There’s no free plan, only a 14-day free trial.
- Pick Growth if you need automations, two-way email sync or sequences. Lite has none of the three.
- Premium is the first plan that includes LeadBooster, Projects and Smart Docs. Check the add-on math before you pay for the jump from $24 to $49.
- Seats are billed whether anyone uses them or not, and seat cuts only apply at renewal. Remove unused seats 10 to 14 days before your renewal date.

...

Pipedrive charges a flat price per seat, per month, on four plans. On annual billing you pay upfront for the year, and it costs less on every plan.

| Plan | Annual billing (per seat a month) | Paid upfront per seat a year | Monthly billing (per seat a month) | Yearly saving per seat |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lite | $14 | $168 | $19 | $60 |
| Growth | $24 | $288 | $34 | $120 |
| Premium | $49 | $588 | $64 | $180 |
| Ultimate | $69 | $828 | $89 | $240 |

Source: Pipedrive pricing page, US dollar prices. Savings are our math: monthly price times 12, minus the annual price.

Here’s the thing most guides miss. Many still list Growth at $39 and Ultimate at $79. Pipedrive’s pricing page now shows $24 and $69 on annual billing, so check the page before you trust an older quote.

...

## What Does the Pipedrive Growth Plan Include?

Growth is where Pipedrive starts doing work for you. It adds workflow automations, email sequences, two-way email sync and email open and click tracking.

The meeting scheduler, email templates, group emailing and revenue forecast reports also start here. So do product subscriptions and installments.

Growth raises the limits too: 5,000 leads and deals per seat, 100 custom fields, 50 reports per seat and 50 active automations per company.

Say your team of five sends the same follow-up after every demo. On Growth, one automation does it. On Lite, five people do it by hand, every time.

For most small teams, this is the plan where Pipedrive pricing is worth it. The extra $10 per seat buys back hours of manual follow-up.

Pricing: $24 per seat a month billed annually, which is $288 a year. Monthly billing costs $34 per seat.

### Best For

...

- Teams that live in Gmail or Outlook and need full email sync.

- 50 automations and 5 sequences per company.
- Two-way email sync, tracking and scheduling in one plan.
- The jump from Lite costs only $10 per seat a month on annual billing.

text:
Pipedrive pricing checked 10 November 2026: Lite $14, Growth $24, Premium $49, Ultimate $69 a seat billed annually, add-ons, limits and first-year costs.

Published prices

Our prices are published, so you can check the numbers before a call.

Gigabit editorial team· November 10, 2026

Pipedrive pricing runs from $14 to $69 a seat a month billed annually, or $19 to $89 billed monthly, across four plans: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate. Add-ons start at $13.33 a month, and Premium and Ultimate include three of them: LeadBooster, Projects and Smart Docs. All prices are in US dollars before VAT, checked on Pipedrive's pricing page on 10 November 2026. By our arithmetic, 20 seats on Premium cost $11,760 a year, about half the $23,100 that 20 HubSpot Sales Hub Professional seats cost in year one.

## Every Pipedrive plan and price

Prices are per seat per month. Pipedrive charges for every seat you buy, "whether it's assigned to a user or not," according to its billing help article. The limits come from the plan comparison table on the same pricing page.

| Growth | $24 a seat ($288 a year) | $34 a seat | Full email sync with open and click tracking; automations and email sequences; product subscriptions and forecasts; meeting scheduler | 5,000 leads and deals per seat; 100 custom fields; 50 reports per seat; 50 automations |

When you reach a limit but do not want to upgrade, Pipedrive sells top-ups.
